Dragon Fruit-Mint Mocktail
By: Simmer + Sauce
Published: Sunday, August 2, 2020 - 3:24pm

Ingredients




1/3 cup dragon fruit
1 ounce freshly squeezed lime juice
1 teaspoon agave
10 mint leaves
2 ounces pineapple juice
splash of club soda
lime wedge (for garnish)
mint sprig (for garnish)

Preparation

1 Place a good amount of ice in a lowball glass and set aside. 2 In a cocktail shaker, add the dragon fruit, lime juice, agave and mint leaves. Using a muddler, mash the mixture together until the dragon fruit and mint and nice and broken up. Add the pineapple juice, a handful of ice and shake vigorously for 30 seconds. 3 Strain into the prepared cocktail glass. Top with club soda, garnish with a lime wedge and mint sprig, and serve immediately.

About

A refreshing dragonfruit-mint mocktail to keep you hydrated in August.
